what_ai_proposed: A 2-week delivery plan derived from the brief text
what_changed: Replanned to ~1 day in 9 fixed blocks with explicit scope cuts
why_it_mattered: The real constraint came from the stakeholder (recruiter) and was not in the document
what_i_would_teach: AI plans from the documents you give it. Confirm real constraints with people first and feed them in; a plan that ignores them is confident and wrong

what_ai_proposed: Pinned dbt-duckdb==1.9.1 from its training knowledge
what_changed: Re-pinned to versions proven by a clean install
why_it_mattered: The AI-chosen pin was yanked and dragged in an incompatible dbt-core; CI and reviewers would have failed on first run
what_i_would_teach: Never accept a version pin you have not installed in a clean environment; AI version knowledge is stale by design

what_ai_proposed: Late-data rule applied to every incoming row before de-duplication
what_changed: Exact retries are detected by content hash first; only new or changed lines are judged against the restatement window
why_it_mattered: All 52 tests were green, yet 167 harmless re-sent lines were held as late - revenue would have been understated and Finance flooded with false restatements
what_i_would_teach: Green tests prove the rules you wrote, not that the rules are right. Profile the output (counts by reason, by batch) and ask whether each number is believable before you trust a pipeline

what_ai_proposed: Synthetic-data generator that re-generated all files when a new batch was added
what_changed: Per-month seeds; demo mode only writes new batch files; verified by hashing landed files before/after
why_it_mattered: Landing zones must be immutable - otherwise replays and incremental runs silently disagree with what was originally loaded
what_i_would_teach: Treat the landing zone as an append-only log and test that property (hash before/after), even in a PoC

what_ai_proposed: Fixed 1% quarantine threshold for the monitoring warning
what_changed: Anomaly rule: 3x trailing 6-batch average for the same source and at least 0.2%
why_it_mattered: The fixed rule never fired on the real incident (0.4%) - monitoring that cannot see an outage is worse than none because it gives false confidence
what_i_would_teach: Set alert thresholds from observed baselines, then prove the alert fires on a known-bad case before calling it done

what_ai_proposed: AI agent built a whole block and pushed it to the shared repo without explaining or asking
what_changed: Rolled back; working agreement: explain -> agree -> build locally -> verify -> push only on explicit approval
why_it_mattered: The lead must understand and own every change that reaches the shared repo; speed without review produced work I could not explain
what_i_would_teach: Give AI tools speed inside gates: they draft and build locally, a human understands and approves before anything is shared. Same rule I would set for a new engineer

what_ai_proposed: YAML catalogue with join keys written as 'on:'
why_it_mattered: PyYAML (YAML 1.1) reads 'on' as boolean True - every join condition silently disappeared and the compiler crashed on first use
what_i_would_teach: Configuration is code: load and test it. Know your parser's quirks (on/off/yes/no are booleans in YAML 1.1)

what_ai_proposed: Leakage tests that only checked the model functions
what_changed: Added a test that independently re-forecasts every stored backtest point from strictly earlier data
why_it_mattered: A deliberately leaked backtest loop (one extra week of future data) passed all original tests - accuracy would have looked better than reality
what_i_would_teach: Prove a test can fail: break the code on purpose (mutation testing) and check the test catches it before trusting a green run

what_ai_proposed: Forecast accuracy reported as one overall WAPE (14.5%)
what_changed: Per-series accuracy with high/medium/low confidence attached to every forecast row
why_it_mattered: The weighted average hid 30-64% error on the single-product Healthy Snacks series - planners would have trusted the worst numbers equally
what_i_would_teach: Averages hide the tail. Always look at the error distribution and tell consumers which numbers are reliable

what_ai_proposed: Diagram accepted because the renderer reported no errors
what_changed: Looked at the rendered image; re-laid out the architecture top-to-bottom
why_it_mattered: 'No errors' is not 'readable' - the main architecture picture had sources at the bottom and eight crossing lines
what_i_would_teach: Review the artefact the audience will see (the picture, the page, the report), not the tool's exit code

what_ai_proposed: Regex/sed edits of SQL and YAML files
what_changed: Parse the structure (or edit by hand) for structured files; re-run the parser after every edit
why_it_mattered: Two edits broke files: leftover read_csv debris in bronze SQL and a decimal type split inside YAML
what_i_would_teach: Structured files deserve structured edits; always re-run the parser or build immediately after a scripted change

what_ai_proposed: Daily-run sequence diagram with every arrow starting at the orchestrator (Lakeflow Jobs)
what_changed: Arrows redrawn between data layers; orchestration shown as a note (found by Ashok in review)
why_it_mattered: An operator reading the old diagram would think the scheduler moves data - wrong mental model for debugging and recovery
what_i_would_teach: Separate control flow from data flow in every diagram, and label which one an arrow means

what_ai_proposed: Migration plan with phase durations but no statement of the client size they assumed
what_changed: Sizing drivers (4 Vs, sources, reports, metric definitions, BUs, readiness, calendar), S/M/L scenarios, per-unit estimating method, assumption A-19 (found by Ashok in review)
why_it_mattered: A small client (1 TB, few reports) could migrate in about a month; a large one needs most of a year - the same numbers would mislead both
what_i_would_teach: Never give a duration without its basis: state the inventory it assumes, the per-unit effort, the capacity, and what would change it

what_ai_proposed: Late data beyond the window held in quarantine with no value shown to consumers (AI design)
what_changed: Official figure plus a pending-restatement amount on every answer, region-scoped (found by Ashok: what do we tell the CEO?)
why_it_mattered: A CEO given only the official figure is silently missing ~1%; given two numbers, she does not know which to use
what_i_would_teach: Design the answer for the person asking: one authoritative number, and an honest statement of how complete it is and what is still to come

what_ai_proposed: Monthly version table of published revenue (AI proposal)
what_changed: Daily summary + daily snapshot so any period can be derived and 'as reported on date X' rebuilt (Ashok's decision)
why_it_mattered: Monthly totals cannot answer weekly, fiscal-period or region-level 'as reported' questions; daily cells can
what_i_would_teach: Store the finest grain consumers will re-aggregate (here: day), and derive every period from it - never store each period separately

what_ai_proposed: Incremental release logic tested with one run only
what_changed: Re-ran three times and against a full rebuild; fixed an older version overriding a newer one
why_it_mattered: The second run silently changed an October adjustment from +2 to +1 units while all tests stayed green
what_i_would_teach: Prove idempotency: run every incremental job at least twice and compare with a full rebuild by content hash
